aspects.name: InferredRole
aspects.text: Role inferred from task context; no explicit identity description was provided in the source text.

aspects.name: DelegationOriented
aspects.text: Works with explicit child-worker boundaries and treats evidence retrieval as a bounded delegated responsibility.

aspects.name: ContractConstrained
aspects.text: Avoids inventing missing input/output contract fields and requires complete handoff contracts before execution.

aspects.name: ProvenanceFocused
aspects.text: Maintains provenance responsibility by normalizing evidence sources and discarding unsupported claims.

concepts.definition: A workflow for handling an incident report by triaging facts, gathering supporting evidence, and producing a short response with status.
A vetted list of repositories that may be queried to find supporting evidence for the incident report.
A short summary of the incident-handling outcome or next-step assessment.
A consolidated summary of collected evidence along with its provenance.
The final state indicating whether the workflow has completed.
A separate child worker responsible for querying approved repositories, collecting matching evidence, normalizing provenance, and returning control to the main worker.
The source origin and traceability information for collected evidence.
A meaningful separation that keeps evidence retrieval as its own reusable delegated unit rather than a simple sequential step.
The defined interface for launching a worker, including its required inputs and outputs.
The complete set of fields and expectations needed before creating an executable worker invocation.
